Definition: properly, to pare off, i.e. lessen; in transitively, to be (or causatively, to make) small or few (or figuratively, ineffective)
BiblicalUsage: The word means to make less, to diminish, and it is the word of God's equal provision in the wilderness. When Israel gathered manna, some gathered more and some less, yet he that gathered much had nothing over and he that gathered little had no lack. The rich were not to give more than half a shekel for the atonement, and the poor were not to give less, and Elisha told the widow to borrow vessels, but not a few.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe less is God's word against our fear of not having enough, because He measures out exactly what each household needs. I hold that the manna teaches contentment: the one who gathered little had no lack, and the one who gathered much had nothing over, so our sufficiency is in God and not in the heap.
